# Paper F: Flux Rank Note

## f1_scope
[SYNTHETIC TEST CORPUS; DOCUMENT_KEY=paper_flux; SECTION_KEY=f1_scope]
Paper Flux Note USES FluxRank. FluxRank TARGETS Method Comparison by combining dense similarity, lexical matches, and graph-expanded evidence.

## f2_dataset
[SYNTHETIC TEST CORPUS; DOCUMENT_KEY=paper_flux; SECTION_KEY=f2_dataset]
FluxRank is EVALUATED_ON MetroReviews. MetroReviews is a Dataset of artificial review snippets about retrieval modes.

## f3_metric
[SYNTHETIC TEST CORPUS; DOCUMENT_KEY=paper_flux; SECTION_KEY=f3_metric]
FluxRank REPORTS Latency P95. Latency P95 is a Metric for checking whether difficult retrieval remains acceptable during demos.

## f4_concept
[SYNTHETIC TEST CORPUS; DOCUMENT_KEY=paper_flux; SECTION_KEY=f4_concept]
FluxRank USES Evidence Stitching. Evidence Stitching lets a ranked list include chunks that complement each other instead of repeating one fact.

## f5_compare
[SYNTHETIC TEST CORPUS; DOCUMENT_KEY=paper_flux; SECTION_KEY=f5_compare]
Paper Flux Note COMPARES_WITH DeltaIndexer. The note separates ranking behavior from incremental indexing behavior.
